description: ΕΓΚΑΤ ΠΛΩΤΩΝ ΝΑΥΠΗΓ Ή ΜΟΝΙΜΗΣ ΑΓΚΥΡΟΒ ΠΛΟΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΙΔΡΥΣΗ ΕΠ ΑΥΤΩΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΥΓΕΙΟΝΟΜΙΚΟΥ ΕΝΔ is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΛΙΜΕΝΙΚΗΣ ΑΣΤΥΝΟΜΙΑΣ. Musterantrag mit den Unterlagen, die für die Ankündigung der Errichtung schwimmender Werften oder der dauerhaften Verankerung von Schiffen und die Einrichtung von Geschäften von gesundheitlichem Interesse auf diesen erforderlich sind. Coverage: ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΛΙΜΕΝΙΚΗΣ ΑΣΤΥΝΟΜΙΑΣ. The portal shows the English title as "Plaukiojančiųjų korpusų arba nuolatinių korpusų įrengimas ir įrengimas ant jų higieninių batų" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΛΙΜΕΝΙΚΗΣ ΑΣΤΥΝΟΜΙΑΣ. Its keywords include Από μετάπτωση, repository.data.gov.gr. The listing shows 2026-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
